title: eriochilus dilatatus subsp. multiflorus
intro: Eriochilus dilatatus subsp. multiflorus, commonly known as the 'many-flowered beard orchid', is a flowering plant species that belongs to the orchid family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Eriochilus dilatatus subsp. multiflorus include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
